title: 推门进大堂，前台起立
summary: She pushes through the lobby glass doors; behind the reception desk the two front-desk girls jump to their feet and the nearer one greets her loudly.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1), in navy overalls with a grey-blue apron and her staff badge on her chest, pushes the lobby's glass door open from outside and steps in.
[Shot 1] Wide down the lobby: the glass door swings in at the near edge of frame and 苏小满 (S1) steps through, the reception counter set off to the right of the depth, the lift bank far at the end.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.200, medium on the reception desk in the right half of frame: the two front-desk girls rise to their feet together, chair legs scraping, both turning to face her.
[Shot 3] At 00:05.600, close on 前台 (S12), a young woman in a navy uniform with a silk scarf, leaning over the counter with a wide smile and speaking in bright eager Mandarin: [Chinese] 苏姐早！
[Shot 4] At 00:08.400, the other receptionist nods along beside her while 苏小满 (S1) keeps walking in along the lobby's depth without slowing. She says nothing.
soundscape: The glass door swinging shut, two chair legs scraping the lobby floor, a bright greeting, a soft piano line from the lobby speakers, shoes on polished stone.
music: A light, gently wry lobby underscore.

title: 目不斜视往里走
summary: She walks on into the lobby without turning her head while the two receptionists stay on their feet watching her back.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) is mid-lobby walking away from the glass door, and 前台 (S12) with the second receptionist stands behind the counter in the right of frame.
[Shot 1] Medium from behind: 苏小满 (S1) walks straight down the lobby's depth, shoulders level and eyes forward, past the counter without a glance.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, over her shoulder: the two receptionists still stand behind the counter in the right of frame, hands folded, eyes following her.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.200, the camera drifts with her toward the corridor mouth at the far end as the lift bank grows nearer; she keeps her mouth closed and says nothing.
soundscape: Her steady footsteps on the stone, the lobby's soft piano, low murmuring from the counter behind her, the hum of the lift bank ahead.

title: 走廊上人人让路
summary: Down the corridor everyone she passes turns sideways to let her through while their eyes stay on her.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) walks out of the lobby into the corridor and continues along the building's depth.
[Shot 1] Wide down the corridor: 苏小满 (S1) comes forward along the centre line while two clerks ahead press themselves back into the walls on either side, opening a path down the middle.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, medium: she passes a security guard who turns his shoulder in and drops his chin as she goes by.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.200, she passes a colleague holding a stack of files who half-steps back into the wall, his face turning to follow her on down the corridor. She says nothing.
soundscape: Soft-soled shoes on the corridor floor, a trolley wheel squeaking, the low murmur of people stepping aside, an air-conditioning hum overhead.

title: 走进更衣间
summary: She comes into the narrow locker room and stops in front of her own metal cabinet, facing the curtain doorway.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) has just passed the last clerk in the corridor and walks on along the corridor's depth toward the locker-room doorway at the far end.
[Shot 1] Medium: 苏小满 (S1) comes down the corridor, reaches the locker-room doorway at the near end and pushes its door curtain aside.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.200, medium: she walks to her own locker and stops in front of it, facing back toward the curtain doorway at the near end.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.200, close: her hand rests on the locker door with her thumb by the lock, and she takes one slow breath. She says nothing.
soundscape: The curtain swishing shut, her footsteps on the concrete floor, locker metal ticking as it settles, an extractor fan whirring overhead.

title: 阿芳打听身世
summary: 阿芳 leans in from her front side, one hand at her mouth, and asks in a low voice whether the rumour about her and the Lu family is true.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) stands in front of her locker facing the curtain doorway, with her hand resting on the locker door.
[Shot 1] Medium: 阿芳 (S5), round-faced in a deep-blue uniform, comes up from 苏小满's (S1) front-left and leans toward her, one hand raised beside her mouth, her eyes flicking toward the curtain.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.500, over-the-shoulder on 苏小满 (S1): 阿芳 (S5) drops her voice to a low murmuring Mandarin and leans closer: [Chinese] 小满，全大厦都传遍了。说你是陆家失散的人？
[Shot 3] At 00:08.000, two-shot: 阿芳 (S5) waits there for an answer, still leaning in, while 苏小满 (S1) keeps her hand on the locker door. Neither one moves.
soundscape: Two low voices close together, the extractor fan overhead, locker metal ticking, faint footsteps out in the corridor.

title: 别信
summary: She pauses with her hand on the locker door and answers in two words: don't believe it.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 阿芳 (S5) still leans in at 苏小满's (S1) front-left waiting, and 苏小满 (S1) stands at her locker with her hand on the door.
[Shot 1] Close on 苏小满 (S1): her hand freezes on the locker door and she answers without turning her eyes from the lock, in a low even Mandarin: [Chinese] 别信。
[Shot 2] At 00:04.200, close on 阿芳's (S5) face as she takes in the answer, straightens a little and glances once more at the curtain.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.000, two-shot: 阿芳 (S5) presses her lips together and stays where she is while 苏小满 (S1) keeps her eyes down on the lock and says nothing more.
soundscape: Two very low voices, the extractor fan, the locker door ticking under her palm, muffled corridor footsteps.

title: 门帘一掀，钱经理拎桶
summary: The curtain at the near end is thrown aside and 钱经理 rushes in at a jog, gripping her blue bucket in both hands.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) stands at her locker facing the curtain doorway and 阿芳 (S5) stands at her front-left.
[Shot 1] Medium from the locker side toward the curtain: the curtain at the near edge is flung back and 钱经理 (S3), heavy-set with slicked hair, a dark waistcoat over a white shirt, hurries in at a half-run with a blue bucket gripped in both hands and water sloshing over the rim.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the camera moves with him as he comes on, already folding forward and pasting on a smile, the bucket swinging at his knees.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.200, wide in the narrow locker room: 阿芳 (S5) shrinks back half a step toward the lockers while 苏小满 (S1) turns her head toward the curtain. Nobody speaks yet.
soundscape: The curtain rings rattling on the rail, quick footsteps, water slapping the bucket sides, the extractor fan overhead.

title: 他拎着水桶赔笑
summary: 钱经理 skids to a stop in front of her, lifts the bucket like an offering and grins out that he tore yesterday's slip up as a joke.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 钱经理 (S3) has just burst in and is folding forward at the near end of the locker room with the blue bucket in both hands, while 苏小满 (S1) faces the curtain at her locker.
[Shot 1] Medium: 钱经理 (S3) brakes to a stop at 苏小满's (S1) front-left and lifts the bucket a little toward her like an offering, his eyes squeezed to slits in a wide grin.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.600, close on 钱经理's (S3) face as he half-laughs out loud greasy Mandarin: [Chinese] 小满！哎呀，昨天那单子，我撕了撕了。闹着玩的！
[Shot 3] At 00:07.600, he frees one hand and mimes tearing a sheet in front of his chest, and 苏小满 (S1) looks at him and lowers her hand from the locker door to her side.
soundscape: His ringing voice bouncing off the metal lockers, water still slapping in the bucket, the extractor fan, a short intake of breath behind him.

title: 想擦哪层擦哪层
summary: He raises his free hand toward the ceiling and offers her any floor she likes, bowing half an inch lower.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 钱经理 (S3) stands bent forward at 苏小满's (S1) front-left with the blue bucket raised in one hand, and 苏小满 (S1) stands at her locker with both hands down at her sides.
[Shot 1] Medium: 钱经理 (S3) lifts his free hand and points it up toward the ceiling, meaning the upper floors, his grin wider and his back bending lower.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, close on 钱经理's (S3) face as he coaxes in soft greasy Mandarin: [Chinese] 往后三楼、顶楼，你想擦哪层擦哪层。
[Shot 3] At 00:08.000, he tips the bucket toward her again with both hands, and 苏小满 (S1) keeps both hands down at her sides without moving.
soundscape: His wheedling voice under the low ceiling, the fan whirring, water ticking in the bucket, locker panels ticking as they settle.

title: 她没有去接桶
summary: She looks at the man who was shaking her down yesterday and does not reach for the bucket he holds out.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 钱经理 (S3) holds the blue bucket out toward her from her front-left, bent low, and 苏小满 (S1) stands at her locker with both hands down at her sides.
[Shot 1] Medium two-shot: 苏小满 (S1) stands still with her hands down and makes no move toward the bucket, her eyes travelling from his face down to the bucket and back up.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.600, close on her face: flat and level, without warmth, the ceiling light sitting on her cheekbones.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.400, she keeps her hands exactly where they are while 钱经理's (S3) offered bucket hangs in the air between them. Neither of them speaks.
soundscape: The fan overhead, water ticking in the bucket, the lockers ticking, a muffled corridor noise beyond the curtain.

title: 三楼贵宾区，不是不让我进了吗
summary: She repeats his own words back at him slowly, asking whether the third-floor VIP area was not closed to her.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) stands with both hands down and her eyes on 钱经理 (S3), who is still bent forward holding out the bucket at her front-left.
[Shot 1] Close over 钱经理's (S3) shoulder on 苏小满 (S1): she speaks slowly, one phrase at a time, in even Mandarin: [Chinese] 三楼贵宾区，不是不让我进了吗。
[Shot 2] At 00:06.000, her eyes stay level on him and her hands remain down at her sides.
[Shot 3] At 00:08.200, 钱经理's (S3) smile stays pinned on his face while his eyes flick sideways off her.
soundscape: Her slow even voice in the narrow room, water settling in the bucket, the extractor fan, someone shifting their weight behind them.

title: 谁说的，我可没说
summary: His grin freezes, he gives two dry laughs and waves the accusation away with a flustered hand.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 钱经理 (S3) is still bent forward with the bucket at 苏小满's (S1) front-left, and 苏小满 (S1) faces him at her locker.
[Shot 1] Close on 钱经理 (S3): the grin locks in place, he gives two dry laughs and waves one hand quickly across in front of his face, his eyes dodging off to the side, as he answers in light flustered Mandarin: [Chinese] 谁说的。我可没说。
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, medium: 苏小满 (S1) watches him wave, unmoved, the bucket still hanging between them.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.200, he lowers his hand and shrugs one shoulder with the grin still stuck on his face. He says nothing more.
soundscape: Two dry laughs, his quick voice, water sloshing in the bucket, the extractor fan overhead.

title: 摘工牌，放桌上
summary: She lifts the lanyard over her head, takes the staff badge off her neck and lays it face-up on the bench table.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) stands at her locker with 钱经理 (S3) bent forward nearby holding the bucket, the long bench table running down the middle of the room.
[Shot 1] Close on her hands: both hands rise to her collar, lift the badge lanyard up over her low ponytail and off her neck.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.800, medium: she steps to the long bench table and lays the badge down face-up on the top, then takes both hands away.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.000, 钱经理 (S3) watches the badge land with the bucket still in his hands while 苏小满 (S1) straightens back up. She says nothing.
soundscape: The lanyard sliding over her collar, her steps on the floor, the badge clicking down on the table top, water ticking in the bucket, the fan overhead.

title: 最后一个月工钱
summary: She presses the badge flat on the table and, looking up at him, tells him to settle her last month's wages.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: the badge lies face-up on the long table and 苏小满 (S1) stands at the table, with 钱经理 (S3) bent forward at her front-left holding the bucket.
[Shot 1] Close on the hand of 苏小满 (S1) as it comes down and presses the badge flat on the tabletop, then she lifts her eyes to him and speaks in a level Mandarin: [Chinese] 最后一个月工钱，结一下。
[Shot 2] At 00:05.400, medium: 钱经理 (S3) stays bent forward, his grin wavering, the bucket hanging from both hands.
[Shot 3] At 00:08.000, 苏小满 (S1) takes her hand off the badge and stands straight, the fan humming overhead between them.
soundscape: Her calm voice, a faint badge click on the table, water sloshing in the bucket, the extractor fan whirring under the ceiling.

title: 桌子我擦，您的脸您自己擦
summary: She turns to go, wiping the table corner on her way past, and leaves him with a line that is not about the table.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) stands beside the long bench table with the badge lying on it, and 钱经理 (S3) is bent forward at her front-left with the bucket.
[Shot 1] Close as 苏小满 (S1) turns and, in passing, wipes the corner of the long table with the flat of her hand and says in a low even Mandarin: [Chinese] 桌子我擦。您的脸，您自己擦。
[Shot 2] At 00:05.600, medium from behind her: she walks toward the curtain at the near end with her back to 钱经理 (S3) and the bucket.
[Shot 3] At 00:08.200, 钱经理 (S3) stands rooted with the bucket in both hands and his mouth half open while 苏小满's (S1) back recedes toward the curtain.
soundscape: Her hand whispering over the table edge, her unhurried steps, water shifting in the bucket, the fan overhead.
music: A single plucked note as she turns.

title: 她走了，他僵在原地
summary: She pushes out through the curtain and he is left standing with the bucket in both hands and his smile stuck.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) is walking away toward the curtain at the near end with her back to 钱经理 (S3), who stands bent forward with the blue bucket in both hands.
[Shot 1] Medium: 苏小满 (S1) throws the curtain aside with one hand and steps out, and the curtain swings and settles behind her.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.800, 钱经理 (S3) does not move; the water in the bucket tilts and slaps the rim as his arms sag.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.600, closer on his face: the smile is stuck and slipping and his mouth hangs half open, his eyes on the empty curtain. He says nothing.
soundscape: The curtain rings sliding on the rail and swishing back, water slapping the bucket, the fan overhead, the locker room's flat echo.

title: 走到角落里拨号
summary: He glances around, hurries to the far corner, sets the bucket down and dials.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 钱经理 (S3) stands mid-room with the blue bucket in both hands, facing the curtain that 苏小满 just went through.
[Shot 1] Medium: he checks over both shoulders, picks up his pace and walks to the rear corner of the narrow locker room.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, he sets the bucket down on the floor at his feet and frees both hands.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.800, close: he pulls a phone from his waistcoat, thumbs a number and lifts it to his ear with his back to the curtain.
soundscape: Quick steps on the concrete, the bucket settling on the floor with a slosh, locker panels ticking, the fan whirring overhead.
music: A low uneasy string under the hum.

title: 压着声音上报
summary: In the corner he reports quietly into the phone that Su Xiaoman has come to settle her wages, that she has a temper, and that he did not dare pay her.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 钱经理 (S3) stands in the rear corner of the locker room with his back to the curtain, the phone at his ear and the blue bucket on the floor at his feet.
[Shot 1] Close on 钱经理 (S3), one hand cupped beside his mouth, his voice kept low, his eyes flicking toward the curtain as he speaks in hushed Mandarin: [Chinese] 喂。跟上面说一声。
[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, 钱经理 (S3) reports in the same low careful Mandarin: [Chinese] 那个苏小满，来结工钱。
[Shot 3] At 00:06.600, 钱经理 (S3) drops his voice further and takes on a note of appeasement: [Chinese] 脾气不小。我没敢给。
soundscape: His hushed voice close to the phone, the extractor fan, water ticking in the bucket at his feet, a faint corridor rattle beyond the curtain.

title: 挂了电话，回头看
summary: The line is cut from the other end; he lowers the phone, looks off toward where she left, and silently picks the bucket back up.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 钱经理 (S3) stands in the rear corner with the phone at his ear and the blue bucket on the floor at his feet.
[Shot 1] Close on the phone against his ear: the call is cut from the other end and the screen dims, and he has not said a word.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.200, he lowers the phone and turns his head toward the curtain and the corridor beyond, the way she went.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.000, medium: he bends, takes the blue bucket up in both hands, his throat moving once, and stands there facing the empty curtain without a word.
soundscape: The line clicking off at the other end, the fan overhead, the bucket lifting off the concrete, distant corridor footsteps and the building's low hum.
music: A soft low string fading out under the hum.
